messages:
sarah_support: Heads up: ACME Analytics (org_8892) requested 3x throughput for product launch tomorrow at 10:00 PT. They want ratecap increased from 20k TPS -> 60k TPS for ~6 hours. Link to ticket: https://support.redwood.com/ticket/45299 Logs attached. Need fraud check + product signoff.
julia_sales: cc @matt_product @liam_engineering - how risky is this? they've been on trial, billing not upgraded yet.
fraud-bot: Automated scan started for org_8892 ... flags: unusual geo distribution, spikes from 14 distinct IPs in last 24h. Risk score: 0.62 (requires manual review).
liam_engineering: Can we do a conditional uplift instead? Live throttle + prefix caching and stricter per-IP caps. Also need sample request headers, API key patterns, and a last-1h RPS histogram.
sarah_support: Sending sample headers + recent 1h histogram. curl snippet for the sample request:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-cust-zz" https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"..."}'
```
julia_sales: Customer says upgrade decision depends on this uplift — it's their launch. They can wire a deposit if we require.
matt_product: Proposal: approve a 12-hour canary uplift to 45k TPS with controls:
- require billing deposit + SAML SSO verified org
- per-IP soft limit 5k/sec
- 5-min moving-average autoscale rollback
- alert to #eng-oncall + #support on >80% error rate
Suggested config snippet:
```
org_id: org_8892
limit_per_min: 2700000
burst: 50000
conditions: [billing_verified, org_sso]
```
liam_engineering: :eyes: I can implement a temporary routing policy + enforcement filter. Need security to validate geo spike sources. Recommend enabling token rotation and session lifespan limits while uplift is active.
security-bot: Security review started. Quick findings: geo spikes align with CDN edge anomalies, no obvious credential stuffing. Recommend 24h intensive monitoring and billing hold until deposit clears.
sarah_support: So final ops plan: approve conditional uplift to 45k TPS for 12h, require deposit + billing upgrade within 24h or auto-revert. I'll inform the customer. Who owns rollback script?
liam_engineering: I'll own rollback + enforcement policy. Will push policy to staging and request emergency deploy window. ETA ~2h.
julia_sales: :thumbsup: I'll get deposit confirmation and legal sign-off for the TOS exception.
sarah_support: Thanks — action items summarized:
- liam_engineering: deploy policy & rollback (ETA 2h)
- matt_product: confirm product metrics to track (latency, 5xx, cost delta)
- julia_sales: collect deposit + confirm billing upgrade
- security-bot: monitor geo spikes and sign off on go/no-go
I'll update ticket #45299 with the conditional approval and timeline. Will keep thread posted. :shipit:
